# Samplesheet

Pass the samplesheet with `--input`. It can be a CSV file with a header row, or
a YAML list. Each row is one image.

## Columns

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: samplesheet -->
<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/generate_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

| Column | Required | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sample` | yes | string |  | Sample name. Must be unique in the samplesheet and contain no spaces. Used as the prefix of every output file. Must match `^\S+$`. |
| `run_backsub` | no | boolean | `false` | Run background subtraction before segmentation. COMET OME-TIFF only. |
| `run_mesmer` | no | boolean | `false` | Segment with Mesmer. At most one of run_mesmer, run_cellpose and run_cellsam can be true per row. |
| `run_cellpose` | no | boolean | `false` | Segment with Cellpose (patched, through sopa). At most one of run_mesmer, run_cellpose and run_cellsam can be true per row. |
| `run_cellsam` | no | boolean | `false` | Segment with CellSAM. At most one of run_mesmer, run_cellpose and run_cellsam can be true per row. |
| `tiff` | yes | string (file-path) |  | Path to the input image: a COMET OME-TIFF or a multi-channel MIBI TIFF. The path cannot contain spaces. Must match `^\S+\.tiff?$`. |
| `nuclear_channel` | no | string |  | Name of the nuclear channel, e.g. DAPI. Required when a segmenter is selected. Must match `^[^"':,]+$`. |
| `membrane_channels` | no | string |  | Names of the membrane channels, separated by ':', e.g. CD45:HLA I. Required when a segmenter is selected. Several channels are combined into one with combine_method. Must match `^[^"':,]+(:[^"':,]+)*$`. |

<!-- END GENERATED: samplesheet -->

## Rules

- `sample` must be unique.
- At most one of `run_mesmer`, `run_cellpose` and `run_cellsam` can be `true`
  in a row.
- At least one `run_*` column must be `true`. A row with only `run_backsub`
  runs background subtraction only.
- `run_backsub` works only on COMET OME-TIFF files.
- `nuclear_channel` takes one channel name. `membrane_channels` takes one or
  more names separated by `:`. When there is more than one membrane channel,
  they are combined with `combine_method` (default `max`).
- Write channel names without quotes. They can contain spaces, but not `"`,
  `'`, `:` or `,`. They must match the channel names in the image exactly.
- File paths must not contain spaces.

## CSV example

```csv
sample,run_backsub,run_mesmer,run_cellpose,run_cellsam,tiff,nuclear_channel,membrane_channels
slide1,true,false,true,false,/data/slide1.ome.tiff,DAPI,CD45:Pan-Cytokeratin
slide2,false,true,false,false,/data/slide2.ome.tiff,DAPI,HLA I
slide3,true,false,false,false,/data/slide3.ome.tiff,,
```

`slide3` runs background subtraction only.

## YAML example

```yaml
- sample: slide1
  run_backsub: true
  run_cellpose: true
  tiff: /data/slide1.ome.tiff
  nuclear_channel: DAPI
  membrane_channels: CD45:Pan-Cytokeratin
- sample: slide2
  run_mesmer: true
  tiff: /data/slide2.ome.tiff
  nuclear_channel: DAPI
  membrane_channels: HLA I
```

Columns that are left out take their default (`false` for the `run_*`
columns).
